mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect 40-degree temperatures with overcast skies near the Military Ridge State Trail, and please note that while the ISS passes overhead tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The City of Verona is currently processing several election notices for the 2026 calendar year and the Plan Commission is preparing to review development projects, including site plans for the Liberty Business Park.
Looking at the schedule for the next month, there are no upcoming community events, though we will be sure to update you as soon as new notices are posted.

In a notable call from October 21, Verona Police assisted at a residence on Basswood Avenue regarding a witnessed cardiac arrest where an O W I status does not apply, but life-saving measures were taken.
Today's flavor of the day is Devil's Food Cake, and you can stop by any time before the store closes at 10:00 PM to grab a treat.
